content:
Hi Kaggle team,

Our latest submission, was accepted by the platform and successfully completed validation, but it has not been activated for matchmaking.

  • Submission status: Complete, score: 600.
  • Only the validation episode is listed; there are no public matches.
  • The interface currently also shows 100 submissions available. (as of October 1)

Could this be a race condition where the active pool was frozen before validation finished, and the submission was not activated afterward?

Could you please investigate why our latest completed submission is missing from the active pool and activate it if eligible?

Thank you!
@dominoweir @bovard @macruzbar
